newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill starts steel stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill starts steel stocks.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Robert Schenosky said he started coverage of steel stocks with the following ratings:
Nucor Corp as near-term neutral, long-term buy
Oregon Steel Mills Inc as near-term accumulate, long-term buy
Rouge Steel Co as near-term neutral, long-term accumulate
AK Steel Holding Corp as near- and long-term accumulate
Cleveland-Cliffs Inc as near-term neutral, long-term accumulate
USX-U.S. Steel Group as near-term neutral, long-term accumulate
Olympic Steel Inc as near-term neutral, long-term buy
Steel Technologies Inc as near-term accumulate, long-term buy
LTV Corp as near- and long-term accumulate
Gibraltar Steel Corp as near-term accumulate, long-term buy
Worthington Industries Inc as near-term neutral and long-term buy
-- and Bethlehem Steel Corp as near- and long-term neutral.
-- Schenosky, formerly with Smith Barney, said, "At this point of the cycle the focus has to be within specific stories within the industry."

-- "One highlight is Oregon Steel given the international oil and gas play as well as its capital program. LTV is trading below book and has almost $8 (a share) in cash and cash equivalent; AK is the profit leader in the industry. And on a smaller cap basis, Steel Tech and Gibraltar are attractive on growth potential," the analyst said.
